summary: Frontend-only test for the new 'Variasi / Barcode' section on /produk-form and multi-barcode -> single variation-picker flow on Transaksi. All 3 acceptance criteria PASS: (1) In 'Variasi' mode both sections render — 'Daftar Harga Variasi' (with form-add-variation) AND a separate 'Variasi / Barcode' section (with form-add-barcode + form-barcode-input-N, placeholder 'Masukkan Barcode'). Tapping 'Tambah Barcode' adds new form-barcode-input-N rows. (2) End-to-end creation succeeded: product 'Soklin' saved with 3 variations (1 pcs=1000 / 1 renteng=10000 / 2 renteng=9000) and 3 barcodes (123456, 789012, 345678). Toast 'Produk ditambahkan' shown. (3) In Transaksi/scan flow, each of the 3 different barcodes typed into scan-mode-input followed by Enter opens the SAME 'Pilih Variasi Soklin' popup showing exactly the same 3 variations, confirming Many Barcodes -> 1 Product -> 1 Variation List. Picking a variation adds it to the cart (toast 'Soklin — 1 pcs ditambahkan'). Unknown barcode still shows 'Barcode ... belum terdaftar'. No red-screen or JS errors seen. Minor react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, props.pointerEvents) but not blocking. Deprecated packages: none detected in the touched files.

issues: Miko mascot floating bubble sometimes visually overlaps the 'Tambah Variasi Harga' / 'Tambah Barcode' buttons on 390x844 viewport. Buttons still function via touch, but the mascot bubble can obscure the section header — consider moving Miko higher or adding margin when the Variasi section is expanded.

react_native_issues.issue: react-native-web console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Present in multiple StyleSheet.create() blocks (e.g. scanModeBox / addBtnPrimary / payBar in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx).
react-native-web console warning: 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'textShadow'.
react-native-web console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (vCenter View uses pointerEvents='box-none' as a prop).

action_items: Optional polish: silence RN-web deprecation warnings by migrating shadow*/textShadow* to boxShadow/textShadow and using style.pointerEvents instead of the prop.
Optional UX: prevent Miko mascot bubble from overlapping the newly added 'Variasi / Barcode' section actions on smaller viewports.
critical_code_review_comments: produk-form.tsx: extraBarcodes is only persisted when priceType === 'variasi' (payload.barcodes = [] otherwise). Correct behavior — verified.
localdb.ts: getByBarcode now correctly checks p.barcode, p.barcodes[], and variation.barcode in that order — verified end-to-end via 3 distinct barcodes all resolving to the same product.

index.tsx (Transaksi): submitBarcode always opens the variant popup when the resolved product has children or variations, regardless of which barcode matched — this is exactly the required behavior (barcode is NOT bound to a specific variation).
produk-form.tsx: extraBarcodes state initializer keeps at least one empty row (['']) so form-barcode-input-0 is always present in Variasi mode, matching the spec.
seed_data_creation: Created a 'Soklin' product at runtime via the UI with 3 variations and 3 barcodes (123456, 789012, 345678). Web preview uses in-memory DB; data is non-persistent across full page reloads (expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview uses in-memory DB. To keep created products alive between screens, navigate IN-APP (bottom-tab click -> produk-add-button -> produk-form) rather than using page.goto between screens — page.goto reloads the Expo bundle and reseeds the in-memory DB. React Native <Pressable> onPress sometimes doesn't fire from Playwright locator.click(force=True) on this app; using locator.dispatch_event('click') is more reliable for the 'Tambah Variasi Harga' / 'Tambah Barcode' / 'Simpan' buttons. Variant popup pills use testID pattern variasi-{variationId}; children (parent_id) use testID variasi-child-{childId}.
